purpose: We exist to accelerate Zambia's transition to clean energy, a connected economy and sustainable mobility, engineering reliable solutions that improve lives, empower industry and protect the environment.
positioning: A trusted national partner for the energy transition, digital infrastructure and clean mobility, delivering measurable impact for clients, communities and investors.
vision: To be the leading and most trusted provider of renewable energy, ICT, electric mobility and specialized sourcing solutions in Zambia and the region, recognised for engineering excellence and transformative impact.
mission: To deliver efficient, uncompromised and client-focused solutions that exceed expectations, powering sustainable growth through technology, energy and innovation while improving quality of life and creating local employment.

values.title: Excellence
values.text: Uncompromising quality across every product and service we deliver.

values.title: Customer-centric
values.text: Clients are at the heart of every decision and every solution.

values.title: Sustainability
values.text: Advancing clean energy and environmentally responsible practice for a better future.

values.title: Innovation
values.text: Embracing new technologies and inventive ways to add value.

values.title: Integrity
values.text: Honesty, transparency and ethics in every interaction.

values.title: Collaboration
values.text: Partnership and teamwork that turn collective strength into results.

values.title: Adaptability
values.text: Agile, flexible and quick to respond to evolving client needs and industry trends.

timeline.title: Foundation
timeline.text: Donmac Limited is incorporated on 23 May 2011 as a Zambian citizen-owned enterprise focused on quality, client-centred supply and service.

timeline.title: ICT and authorised partnerships
timeline.text: Becomes an HP partner and authorised reseller, and an authorised distributor of Thales (Gemalto) digital identity and security solutions.

timeline.title: Renewable energy scale-up
timeline.text: Expands solar EPC and standby power capability, working with global inverter, battery and module manufacturers.

timeline.title: Flagship public-sector delivery
timeline.text: Delivers commercial solar car-park lighting for Levy Mwanawasa Medical University, alongside work for other public institutions.

timeline.title: Mining and community energy
timeline.text: Delivers hybrid solar systems for Maamba Energy and the Kabanga Lithium Project, and rural electrification for Chipili Town Council's civic centre and five health posts.

timeline.title: Donmac Group
timeline.text: Consolidates into a four-division group (Energy, ICT, e-Mobility and Specialized Sourcing), positioned for regional growth and investment.

whyDonmac.title: Engineering-led delivery
whyDonmac.text: Qualified engineers lead every project, from load analysis and system design to commissioning and certified handover.

whyDonmac.title: End-to-end solutions
whyDonmac.text: Design, supply, installation, commissioning and after-sales support delivered in-house, reducing client risk and interfaces.

whyDonmac.title: Global technology sourcing
whyDonmac.text: Direct access to leading manufacturers in ICT, energy storage, inverters and electric mobility, with quality checked before it ships.

whyDonmac.title: Proven project experience
whyDonmac.text: A documented record of commissioned work for mining companies, a national medical university and a town council.

whyDonmac.title: Quality and safety assurance
whyDonmac.text: Tier-1 components, manufacturer-approved methods, structured QA/QC checkpoints and safe systems of work on every site.

whyDonmac.title: Local expertise, lasting support
whyDonmac.text: A Lusaka-based team that stays with the asset: monitoring, maintenance, warranty management and fast response.

hse.title: Environmental care
